build_graph_transducer: build a weighted finite-state transducer graph with nodes and arcs using gtn.Graph
test_forward_score: test the forward score algorithm on a graph transducer to compute log-sum-exp of all path weights
test_viterbi_path: test the viterbi path algorithm to find the highest-scoring path through a graph transducer
compose_graph_transducers: compose two graph transducers together using gtn.compose to chain input-output mappings
remove_epsilon_transitions: remove epsilon transitions from a graph transducer using gtn.remove to simplify the graph
